name: Variable Bit Rate Color Compression with Macro Blocks
aliases: Compressing Color Data for Voxelized Surface Geometry (Extension)
definition: A compression format for sparse 3D color data that uses variable bits per weight (bpw) to optimize compression ratio, addressing the limitation of fixed bpw methods where theoretical optimal compression is constrained by header overhead.
summary: Variable Bit Rate Color Compression with Macro Blocks compresses sparse 3D color data by using macro blocks to localize header offsets, reducing pointer bit-width and enabling efficient variable bit-rate encoding without prohibitive header sizes.
